Jetio.//kids: Animation and Family titles go to /library/Kids/Movies and /Kids/Shows. Set KidsFolderName to "" to keep everything together.
Jetio.//publicBaseUrl: Replace with this host's LAN address. Baked into every .strm file and handed to playback devices, so localhost will not do.

StremioServer.//: MUST be LAN-reachable from Jellyfin and its players - jetio redirects them here. Never a docker-internal hostname. Port 11471 is the socat bridge from docker-compose.yml, not the server's own 11470.

StreamSelection.//verify: Rejects releases whose name is not the title you asked for. Torrentio sometimes indexes the wrong film against an IMDb id.

Managed.//: Titles added through the web UI at the jetio root URL.

Cinemeta.//: Bulk auto-import. Off by default - it adds ~1700 titles you did not pick. Use the web UI instead.

Jellyfin.//libraries: Names of your jetio libraries in Jellyfin. Only these are rescanned. Leave empty and EVERY library is rescanned, which is slow when you also hold real media.
Jellyfin.//analyze: Ask Jellyfin to probe each title added through the web UI, so it knows the container, codecs and bitrate. Never done during bulk syncs.
